[[Gift of Relics]] is a [[gift]] used in crafting of the [[Legendary Relic]].

== Acquisition ==
=== Recipe ===
{{Recipe
| source = Mystic Forge
| quantity = 1
| ingredient1 = 25 Mystic Facet
| ingredient2 = 25 Mystic Clover
| ingredient3 = 150 Glob of Ectoplasm
| ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Research
}}

== Used in ==
{{recipe list}}

== Note ==
* A grand total of 18,750 [[Pile of Lucent Crystal|Lucent Crystal]] is required to forge the necessary amount of facets for this gift, or 187,500 [[Lucent Mote]]s. If buying all (or most) of either material off the [[Trading Post]] from Sell Orders, one should calculate gold values several listings ahead in order to get the true final value, due to the sheer volume of Lucent required for this gift.
